title: Stephen Braude's First Person Plural on multiple personality as possession

tellings.quote: Um Steve Browy touched on these in his first book, First Person Plural, which included a chapter about how uh there were cases of multiple personality disorder

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says that another philosopher, Stephen Braude of the University of Maryland, Baltimore, wrote a first book called First Person Plural that included a chapter on cases of multiple personality disorder. Jorjani raises it because, as he frames it, some of those cases might be better explained as possession by an outside intelligence.
